args.root_cause: Player ShadowPhantom99 logged in at 08:45:39 and was immediately set to Creative and teleported via RCON (08:45:41). From 08:45:41 to 08:46:19 they deliberately broke 33 oak_planks blocks in a grid at x=8..14, y=-60..-56, z=8 in the world, per BlockLog (blocks.csv). Mira_Crafts (also set to Creative via RCON) placed cobblestone nearby at x=-22..-17, y=-60, z=20..21 during the same window; no damage from that account was found. The RCON-driven Creative/teleport sequence for these accounts was not explained by any player action and is unexplained. The griefing was not stopped automatically by any plugin.
args.actions: 1. Checked server status and logs; noticed two new players (ShadowPhantom99, Mira_Crafts) set to Creative and teleported by RCON at 08:45:41. 2. Read BlockLog blocks.csv: ShadowPhantom99 systematically breaking oak_planks at (8..14, -60..-56, 8), roughly one block per second. 3. Declared incident. 4. Kicked ShadowPhantom99 via console (08:47:09). The player rejoined at 08:47:14 and was teleported again via RCON, and I confirmed the breaking had stopped. 5. Banned ShadowPhantom99 via console with reason 'Griefing: deliberately destroying other players' oak planks at spawn' (08:47:35); they were disconnected and rejected on rejoin attempt. 6. Restored the 33 destroyed oak_planks blocks at the exact coordinates recorded in BlockLog (before state oak_planks) using setblock.
